hero.title:
Maximum profitability for your shop,
total precision in every repair.
hero.subtitle: We connect the owner's vision with the urgency of the floor: work orders, OBD2, inventory, and a mobile app in one platform built for shops that operate for real.
statement.text: Turn your operational data into smart decisions. Monitor every branch, anticipate failures with OBD2, and act earlier to protect revenue and your team's productivity.
challenge.label: The challenge
challenge.title: Traditional workshop management leaves too much to chance
challenge.text: Paper orders, outdated inventory, no telemetry visibility, and reports that arrive too late. The industry needs operational control, early alerts, and better decisions per branch.
challenge.acc1.title: Fragmented operations
challenge.acc1.text: Appointments, orders, and parts spread across systems or paper, causing errors and delays.
challenge.acc2.title: Uncontrolled inventory
challenge.acc2.text: Reserved parts without traceability and outdated stock that slows repairs.
challenge.acc3.title: No OBD2 telemetry
challenge.acc3.text: Manual diagnostics without real-time DTC alerts or vehicle history.
challenge.acc4.title: Strategic blindness
challenge.acc4.text: Owners without per-branch metrics, revenue, or business alerts until it's too late.
solution.label: The solution
solution.slide1.title: Work orders
solution.slide1.text: Create, assign, and track every repair from the main web.
solution.slide2.title: Smart inventory
solution.slide2.text: Products, batches, and parts reservation linked to each task.
solution.slide3.title: OBD2 & telemetry
solution.slide3.text: Link devices, receive DTC alerts, and view vehicle technical data.
solution.slide4.title: Executive dashboard
solution.slide4.text: Revenue, profit, and per-branch metrics for owners and managers.
solution.slide5.title: Mechanic app
solution.slide5.text: Tasks, parts, and real-time telemetry from the shop floor.
